q1.sampleAnswer: My name’s Li Na. I’m thirteen years old. I live in Hangzhou, in the east of China. I live with my mum, my dad and my grandmother. I find English the easiest subject at school, because I practise it every day and I like learning new words. I usually listen to pop music, especially when I’m doing my homework. I like cats best, because they’re quiet and very cute. Yes, I like shopping, because I enjoy looking at clothes with my friends, but I don’t buy much. I take photos almost every weekend with my phone, because I like keeping memories of the places I visit. I like funny films and cartoons, because they make me relax. I usually meet my friends at the shopping centre near my home, because there’s a nice café there. Yes, I enjoy playing games on my phone, but I only play for a short time at the weekend.

q1.explanationZh: 好的回答对每个问题都用完整句子作答，并补充理由或细节（because…, usually…, especially…），能用一般现在时、频率副词和 like/enjoy doing 等结构，语言自然流畅。

q2.sampleAnswer: In this photograph I can see four young people playing music together. I think they’re in a school hall, because there’s a big dark red curtain behind them and a wooden floor. On the left, there’s a girl in a flowery shirt. She’s playing a guitar and she looks very relaxed. Next to her, a boy in a checked shirt is playing the piano, and there’s some music on the piano. Behind him, another boy in a pink jacket is standing and playing a small guitar. On the right, a girl in a white top is sitting on a chair and playing a black guitar. She’s looking at her guitar carefully. Maybe they’re in a band and they’re practising for a school concert. I think they’re enjoying themselves.

q2.explanationZh: 好的描述要说清人物在做什么、穿什么、在哪里，以及乐器等物品，用 on the left / next to / behind / on the right 等方位词组织，并用 I think / maybe 合理推测；不会的词（如 ukulele）可以换种说法（a small guitar），持续说满约一分钟。

q3.sampleAnswer: Yes, I agree. A games room is a great idea, because teenagers can play table tennis and chess with their friends after school. Computers are useful too, because lots of students need them for homework, but many teenagers have computers at home. You’re right, the shop with pens and pencils isn’t very exciting, because you can buy those things anywhere. I think the café outside is nice, because people can relax and chat there in summer. The film room is fun as well, but I think teenagers would like the café more, because they can go there every day. Hmm, I think the games room would be the most popular with teenagers, because it’s fun and they can meet new friends there. So shall we choose the games room? Great, we agree.

q3.explanationZh: 好的回答能回应搭档的每个观点（同意/不同意并说明理由），比较不同设施的优缺点，用 I think / You’re right / What about…? / Shall we…? 等推动讨论，最后和搭档一起选出最受青少年欢迎的设施。

q4.sampleAnswer: I go to the library about once a month, because I like borrowing new books, and it’s a quiet place to do homework. I enjoy reading adventure stories and comics, because they’re exciting and easy to read. I prefer watching a TV programme about something, because the pictures help me understand it, but books give you more information. Yes, I’ve read a short book in English. It was a bit difficult, but it helped me learn new words. I think every town should have a library, because not everyone can buy books, and students need a quiet place to study.

q4.explanationZh: 好的回答对每个问题表明观点并给出理由或例子，能用现在完成时（I’ve read…）谈经历，用 prefer… because…, but… 比较两种选择，用 because / but / and 展开，回答切题、连贯。
